meta_description: Gallacher Plumbing serves Coventry with fast emergency repairs, installations, and maintenance. Gas Safe registered. Same-day callouts available.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler breakdown? Gallacher Plumbing reaches you in under an hour, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to new bathroom suites and heating installations, we handle every job with speed and precision.

services.title: Emergency Call-Outs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages sorted fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to fix most problems on the first visit.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Installation
services.desc: Gas Safe certified repairs and brand-new boiler installations with 10-year guarantees. Diagnostic and quotes are free.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: System maintenance, power flushing, and full heating installation. Keep your heating running efficiently and cut energy bills.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: Complete bathroom overhauls from suite selection to tiling and plumbing. We manage the whole project end to end.

services.title: Drain Cleaning & Unblocking
services.desc: Clogged drains cleared using camera inspection and jet cleaning. We find the root cause and fix it properly.

services.title: Radiator & Pipe Work
services.desc: Radiator replacement, bleeding, and new pipework throughout your home. All work certified and guaranteed.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I was tired of cowboys overcharging my neighbours.
about_para_1: Gallacher Plumbing was founded in 2007 on a simple promise: fair pricing, fast response, and no surprise call-out fees. Over nearly two decades, we've built our reputation across Coventry by showing up on time, carrying the right parts, and getting the job done right. We're Gas Safe registered and fully insured on every visit.
about_para_2: Most of our work now comes from word-of-mouth referrals and repeat customers who trust us to fix their heating without the hard sell. We've invested in modern diagnostics and training so we can spot problems quickly and explain what's needed in plain English. Your home is not just a job to us — it's someone's sanctuary.
reviews_heading: What Coventry Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe in the kitchen at 11pm on a Sunday. Called Gallacher and Pete was here within 45 minutes. He sorted it quickly, checked the rest of the system, and didn't overcharge. Can't ask for better service than that. Brilliant.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: New boiler installation needed after our old one gave up. The team were professional, tidy, and finished on time. Ten-year guarantee included and they explained how to use the new controls properly. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Janet K.

reviews.text: Blocked drain had us panicking. Gallacher came out same day, used a camera to find the blockage, and cleared it without digging up the garden. Honest advice, fair price. Will use again next time we need anything.
reviews.author: David W.
